story: The Rescue (15-20 seconds, no dialogue). Two original stickman characters enter an industrial workshop. One tries to move a heavy metal container, loses control, and becomes trapped beneath a falling support. The second character notices the danger, runs to help, struggles to lift the obstruction, and uses a nearby lever to free the first character. The final moment should communicate relief and friendship without dialogue.
